name: Curt Smith
description:
'''Curt Smith''' (born 24 June 1961) is an English singer, songwriter, musician, and record producer. He is best known as the co-lead vocalist, bassist, and co-founder of the [[pop rock]] band [[Tears for Fears]] with childhood friend [[Roland Orzabal]]. Smith has co-written several of the band's songs and performed lead vocals on "[[Mad World]]", "[[Pale Shelter]]", "[[Change (Tears for Fears song)|Change]]", "[[The Way You Are (Tears for Fears song)|The Way You Are]]", "[[Everybody Wants to Rule the World]]", and "[[Advice for the Young at Heart]]".

After leaving Tears for Fears in 1991, Smith released his debut solo studio album, ''[[Soul on Board]]'', in 1993. He later formed the band Mayfield and released further solo recordings, alongside making appearances in film and television. He rejoined Tears for Fears in 2000.
